### Tidying the gtdbtk df

```{r first try at tidy}
gtdbtk |>
  separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |> 
  group_by(user_genome) |>
  slice_tail(n=3) |> 
  summarise(short_classification=paste(classification, collapse = " "))
```

```{r tidy table}
gtdbtk_taxonomy <- gtdbtk |> 
separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |> # split the classification string into long format
  mutate(rank= str_extract(classification, "^[dpcofgs](?=__)")) |> # extract just the single rank letter
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rank, 
    values_from = classification
  ) |> # pivot wider using the letters as temporary collumn names 
   rename(
    domain  = d,
    phylum  = p,
    class   = c,
    order   = o,
    family  = f,
    genus   = g,
    species = s
  ) |> # rename the letter columns o theire taxonomic names 
  mutate(across(
    c(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species),
    ~ str_remove(.x, "^[a-z]__")
  )) |> # Take away the start letter and undercore (f_)
  select(user_genome, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) # selects only the collumns i want in this df

gtdbtk_taxonomy
```
